lines: Sunday night. Three deadlines. Zero plan.
周日晚上。三个截止日期。零计划。
An essay. Two chapters to read. And a quiz on Friday.
一篇论文。两章要读。周五还有小测。
So you open your laptop, and somehow, an hour of scrolling later, nothing has started.
于是你打开电脑，不知怎么刷了一小时，什么都没开始。
The problem usually isn't you. The task is just too big to start.
问题通常不在你，而是这个任务大到无从下手。
In the next three minutes, let's turn that mess into a plan for your week.
接下来三分钟，我们把这团乱麻变成一周计划。
Three moves. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
三个动作：拆碎、排进、核对。
And stay until the end, because there's one slot most plans forget to leave empty.
坚持看到最后，因为有一个空档大多数计划都忘了留。
Move one. Smash it.
第一步：拆碎。
Take the biggest task. Write the essay.
拿出最大的任务：写论文。
You can't finish that in one sitting. So break it.
你没法一次坐下来写完，所以把它拆开。
Choose a topic.
选题。
Find three sources.
找三份资料。
Write an outline.
写提纲。
Draft the intro.
写引言初稿。
Draft the body.
写正文初稿。
Edit and submit.
修改并提交。
Six pieces. Each one starts with a verb, and each one has a clear finish line.
六块。每块都以动词开头，每块都有明确的终点。
Quick test. Could you start it in the next five minutes? If not, smash it again.
快速测试：你能在五分钟内开始吗？不能就再拆。
Now the reading and the quiz. Four more pieces.
再拆阅读和小测，又是四块。
Three scary tasks just became ten small ones.
三个吓人的任务变成了十个小块。
Move two. Slot it.
第二步：排进。
Here's your week. But don't fill it yet.
这是你的一周，但先别填。
First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.
先把已占用的时间划掉：上课、工作、吃饭、休息。
What's left is your real study time. In this example, about an hour on weeknights, and more on Saturday.
剩下的才是真正的学习时间。在这个示例里，工作日晚上约一小时，周六更多。
Your week will look different, and that's fine.
你的一周会不一样，这没关系。
Deadlines go first. The quiz is on Friday, so the reading lands early.
截止日期优先。小测在周五，所以阅读排在前面。
The essay pieces fill the gaps.
论文的小块填进空隙。
And remember that slot I mentioned? Here it is.
还记得我说的那个空档吗？就在这里。
Leave one slot empty. On purpose.
故意留一个空档。
Because something usually takes longer than you expect.
因为总有事情比预想的更久。
Move three. Check it.
第三步：核对。
Every night, take two minutes and tick off what's done.
每天晚上花两分钟，勾掉完成的事。
Monday. Done. Tuesday. Done.
周一，完成。周二，完成。
Wednesday. The outline ran long.
周三，提纲超时了。
No panic. That's what the empty slot is for.
别慌，空档就是为这个准备的。
Move it to Saturday. The plan bends instead of breaking.
把它挪到周六。计划会弯，但不会断。
And if a piece keeps slipping, it's still too big. Smash it again.
如果某块一再拖延，说明它还太大，再拆一次。
At the end of the week, ask two questions.
周末问自己两个问题。
What worked? And what will I change next week?
什么有效？下周我要改什么？
So that's the whole method. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
这就是整个方法：拆碎、排进、核对。
You don't need a perfect plan. You need one you'll actually start.
你不需要完美的计划，你需要一个真的会开始的计划。
Pick one task tonight, and smash it into pieces.
今晚挑一个任务，把它拆碎。
Thanks for watching.
感谢观看。
